title: Chaos Constellations
author: dawsonjones2020
rules:
I am really happy with the flow of logic on this one. I hope you enjoy! If you do, feel free to leave a comment and check out my other puzzles! The star battle rule was inspired by this puzzle by Elliptical.

Solve on SudokuPad

Rules

Chaos Construction: Divide the grid into EIGHT orthogonally connected regions of nine cells. Each row, column and region contains the digits 1-9 once each.

Star Battle: The ninth region consists of nine disjoint cells that act as stars in a star-battle puzzle. Each row and column contains one of those stars and the stars may not touch each other, not even diagonally.

Quadruples: Digits in a large circle must appear in at least one of the four cells surrounding the circle. Quadruple circles must touch four different regions.

White Kropki: Cells separated by a white dot are consecutive and are in different regions.
